items.title: NEC approves additional N130bn for police training institutions
items.summary: The National Economic Council (NEC) has approved an additional N130 billion for the rehabilitation of police training institutions across Nigeria, bringing the total funding for the programme to N230 billion.

items.title: NVIDIA reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.summary: NVIDIA has reinstated Jensen Huang as President and Chief Executive Officer, following a unanimous vote by its Board of Directors after a review of his leadership and potential national security concerns.
